debug.changelog:
ci: install the android-37.1 platform and ignore __pycache__

The build now needs compileSdk 37 with compileSdkMinor = 1, so GitLab CI and Woodpecker have to provision platforms;android-37.1 instead of 37.0, otherwise checkAarMetadata fails on tor-android 0.4.9.12. BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS documents the same requirement for local setups, and scripts/__pycache__ no longer shows up as untracked.

release.changelog:
fix: move Libbox version logging to background thread to avoid ANR

Accessing the `Libbox` class on the main thread during `onCreate` could trigger an ABBA deadlock in Gomobile class initialization (racing between `SetupOptions.<clinit>` and `Libbox.<clinit>`). This blocked the main thread, prevented the service from calling `startForeground()` in time, and resulted in an ANR-kill of the `:vpn` process.

The version log is now moved into the background initialization coroutine to ensure class loading happens safely off the main thread.
